sr.question: Za koliko osoba je Apartman Dragićević?
sr.answer: Apartman je prijavljen za najviše 4 osobe. Ima jednu spavaću sobu sa dva francuska ležaja, a u dnevnom boravku se nalazi ugaona garnitura na razvlačenje.

en.question: How many guests can stay at Apartman Dragićević?
en.answer: The apartment is registered for up to 4 guests. It has one bedroom with two double beds, and a corner sofa that unfolds in the living room.

sr.question: Da li deca borave besplatno?
sr.answer: Deca od 0 do 7 godina borave besplatno.

en.question: Do children stay for free?
en.answer: Children aged 0 to 7 stay for free.

sr.question: Kako mogu da rezervišem direktno?
sr.answer: Možete pozvati na +381 65 8103247 ili poslati zahtev preko forme na sajtu apartmandragicevic.com. Apartman je dostupan i na Booking-u.

en.question: How can I book directly?
en.answer: Call +381 65 8103247 or send a request through the form on apartmandragicevic.com. The apartment is also available on Booking.com.

sr.question: Kada je check-in i check-out?
sr.answer: Check-in je od 14:00, a check-out do 11:00 narednog dana.

en.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
en.answer: Check-in is from 2:00 PM and check-out is until 11:00 AM the next day.

sr.question: Gde se nalazi Apartman Dragićević?
sr.answer: Apartman je u Bogatiću, u Mačvi, na adresi Pavla Orlovića 11. Do centra Bogatića je 100 m, do autobuske stanice 450 m, do Šapca 21 km, a do aerodroma Nikola Tesla u Beogradu 89,4 km.

en.question: Where is Apartman Dragićević located?
en.answer: The apartment is in Bogatić, in the Mačva region of Serbia, at Pavla Orlovića 11. It is 100 m from the town center, 450 m from the bus station, 21 km from Šabac and 89.4 km from Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport.

sr.question: Da li apartman ima parking?
sr.answer: Da, parking je besplatan za sve goste.

en.question: Is there parking?
en.answer: Yes, parking is free for all guests.

sr.question: Da li apartman ima klimu i Wi-Fi?
sr.answer: Da, apartman ima klimu, besplatan Wi-Fi i Smart TV.

en.question: Does the apartment have air conditioning and Wi-Fi?
en.answer: Yes, it has air conditioning, free Wi-Fi and a Smart TV.

sr.question: Da li je kuhinja opremljena?
sr.answer: Da, kuhinja je potpuno opremljena: indukciona ploča, mikrotalasna, frižider, kuvalo i pribor za jelo. Kafa i slatkiši su besplatni.

en.question: Is the kitchen fully equipped?
en.answer: Yes. The kitchen has an induction hob, microwave, refrigerator, electric kettle and cutlery and cookware. Coffee and sweets are free.

sr.question: Da li su peškiri i posteljina uključeni u cenu?
sr.answer: Da, svaki gost dobija čiste peškire, čistu posteljinu i higijenski set.

en.question: Are towels and bed linen included?
en.answer: Yes, every guest gets clean towels, clean bed linen and a hygiene kit.

sr.question: Da li apartman ima veš mašinu?
sr.answer: Da, apartman ima veš mašinu, kao i peglu sa daskom i fen za kosu.

en.question: Is there a washing machine?
en.answer: Yes, the apartment has a washing machine, an iron with ironing board, and a hair dryer.

sr.question: Da li apartman ima dvorište?
sr.answer: Da, gostima je na raspolaganju dvorište.

en.question: Is there a yard or garden?
en.answer: Yes, guests can use the yard.

sr.question: Da li su kućni ljubimci i pušenje dozvoljeni?
sr.answer: Kućni ljubimci nisu dozvoljeni. Pušenje je dozvoljeno.

en.question: Are pets and smoking allowed?
en.answer: Pets are not allowed. Smoking is allowed.

Ima jednu spavaću sobu sa dva francuska ležaja, dnevni boravak sa ugaonom garniturom na razvlačenje i potpuno opremljenu kuhinju. Parking i Wi-Fi su besplatni, a gostima je na raspolaganju i dvorište.
Svaki gost dobija čiste peškire, čistu posteljinu i higijenski set. U apartmanu su besplatni kafa i slatkiši.
